article.headline: Hawaii Islands Brace for Flooding as Torrential Rain Swamps Eastern Counties
article.summary: A statewide flood watch remains in effect for all islands except Kauai and Niihau through early Thursday due to persistent heavy rainfall.
article.body: Rainfall rates reaching up to 2.5 inches per hour have forced road closures and triggered emergency measures across Hawaii. In Hana, police shuttered the Piilani Highway at mile marker 51, while local authorities opened a temporary evacuation site at Helene Hall on Keawa Place to provide a safe gathering space for residents. The heavy precipitation prompted the total closure of all schools on Molokai on Wednesday, leaving officials to manage the immediate impact of inundated roads and rising water levels.  The current weather pattern is driven by a surface trough carrying an airmass holding double the usual moisture content, which has resulted in persistent, unstable conditions across the state. According to the National Weather Service, Doppler radar identified the most severe downpours hitting windward areas of Oahu and eastern Maui, specifically impacting towns like Kailua and Kaneohe. While some areas experienced only light drizzle, high-capacity moisture levels have maintained a consistent threat of minor flooding in low-lying and windward neighborhoods.  Residents should anticipate the flood watch to persist through early Thursday as the trough moves eastward. Meteorologists expect conditions to show gradual improvement throughout Thursday and Friday, with a return of trade winds by the weekend. While the forecast for Halloween trick-or-treating currently suggests mainly light impacts in windward and mountain areas, the First Alert Weather Team continues to monitor the region for any shifts in the trough's path.

article.headline: Nathan Lyon bowls Temba Bavuma as Australia tightens grip on Test decider
article.summary: South Africa holds a slim 40-run lead with six wickets remaining at stumps on day three of the third Test against Australia.
article.body:
South Africa finished the third day of the decisive third Test at Newlands in a precarious position, trailing by only 40 runs after losing captain Temba Bavuma in the penultimate over. Australia entered the final stages of the day with significant momentum, as a delivery from Nathan Lyon spun through Bavuma’s flick to bowl the batter for 35, leaving the hosts at 140 for four heading into the fourth morning. The dismissal marked the fourth time Bavuma has fallen to spin during the current series.

This final Test match carries massive stakes, as the series is currently tied at 1-1. The eventual winner of this clash will secure the top spot in the Test world rankings, a position currently held by Australia. With the pitch at Newlands showing increasing signs of wear and dust, batting is expected to become significantly more difficult as the game concludes, making the 40-run lead look insufficient for the home side to successfully defend against an aggressive Australian bowling attack.

Australia’s dominance earlier in the day was anchored by Josh Inglis, who matched his career-best score by hammering a 132-ball century. His 102, combined with Alex Carey’s 80, propelled Australia to a first-innings total of 429 and a lead of 100 runs. South Africa attempted to stabilize their innings through Marques Ackerman, who scored a vibrant 62 off 80 balls, but his departure following a venomous bouncer from Mitchell Starc halted the momentum. Ackerman was dismissed after a controversial moment where he ran out of time to request a review, with replays later confirming the ball had grazed his glove.

Play resumes on the fourth morning with Matthew Breetzke on 19 and Ryan Rickelton on eight. Australia remains wary of setting a specific target, with players suggesting a total of 200 runs could prove difficult to chase as the pitch continues to deteriorate.

article.headline: Golden State Valkyries and Atlanta Dream Tip Off in Unusual Midday Duel
article.summary: The Golden State Valkyries lead 3-2 against the Atlanta Dream in a WNBA Finals Game 6 shifted to a 12:30 p.m. ET start.
article.body:
The 12:30 p.m. ET start time for Thursday’s WNBA Finals Game 6 forces fans and business owners to scramble, with some women’s sports bars adjusting opening hours to as early as 8:30 a.m. PT to accommodate the rare weekday daytime schedule. While the game at State Farm Arena in Atlanta is sold out, the timing has forced small businesses across the country to pivot their operations to capture demand, with some venues introducing brunch menus and remote work stations to survive the midday broadcast.

This scheduling shift arrives after a late-stage scramble between the WNBA, the Atlanta Dream, and the Atlanta Hawks, who share the arena. The Dream, currently down 2-3 in the series, had previously expressed concerns regarding potential scheduling conflicts two months prior to the playoff window. League sources maintain it remains the responsibility of teams to secure an alternative arena when conflicts arise, though discussions involving NBA and WNBA leadership failed to find a prime-time alternative at a larger venue than the 3,500-seat Gateway Center Arena, leading to the decision to utilize the Hawks' home court during the day.

For sports bars, the financial impact is significant. Venues that typically rely on evening game-day revenue report that the midday slot creates substantial logistical and budgetary burdens. Some owners anticipate thousands of dollars in lost revenue compared to previous seasons as fans struggle to clear their weekday calendars to watch the elimination matchup.

If the Atlanta Dream wins on Thursday, the series will extend to a Game 7 in San Francisco. That deciding game is currently scheduled for Saturday, Oct. 31, a date that creates further competition for venue crowds as it overlaps with holiday celebrations.

The gap between the two sides highlights the pressure on Al-Nassr to secure three points as they continue their pursuit of league leaders Al-Hilal.

Manager Ange Postecoglou has implemented significant changes to the squad that previously defeated Al-Faisaly 3-1. These tactical adjustments see Angelo Gabriel, Ayman Yahya, and Mohamed Simakan enter the starting eleven, replacing Samu Costa, Awad Aman, and Abdulelah Al-Amri respectively. Supporting the attacking duo of Cristiano Ronaldo and Sadio Mane, the midfield and attacking support includes Joao Felix and Abdullah Al-Hamdan, while the defensive line features Nawaf Boushal, Mohamed Simakan, Inigo Martinez, and Ayman Yahya.

For Al-Nassr, maintaining this momentum is essential to closing the gap at the top of the table. article.body:
The 2008 triumph, which marked the first of Cristiano Ronaldo’s five career Ballon d’Or wins, captured the inaugural Ballon d’Or of All Time (B.O.A.T.) honor. Fans placed the 2008 victory ahead of Lionel Messi’s 2012 win and Ronaldo’s own later successes in 2016 and 2017 to secure the top spot. The vote concluded on October 27, with the result announced just days after Harry Kane claimed the 2026 Ballon d’Or.

This recognition highlights the lasting impact of Ronaldo’s breakout season at Old Trafford, where he functioned as the centerpiece of Sir Alex Ferguson’s squad. For fans and analysts, the award serves as a formal acknowledgment of his peak form during a campaign that saw him transform from a teenage winger into a dominant global force. While multiple-time Ballon d’Or winners were eligible for the fan-led contest, the B.O.A.T. distinction carries no physical trophy.

During that iconic 2008 season, Ronaldo netted 31 goals in 34 Premier League matches to claim the Golden Boot. Across all competitions, he recorded 42 goals, including a crucial strike in the Champions League final against Chelsea. That match, which ended 1-1 before Manchester United triumphed on penalties in Moscow, was a defining moment in his career. Yahoo Sports reports that Ronaldo, who currently plays for Al-Nassr, is now closing in on a career total of 1,000 goals.

The voting process, launched by the Ballon d’Or organization, required participants to pay €1 to cast their ballot. The initiative allowed fans to differentiate this title from the Super Ballon d’Or, focusing exclusively on the best individual year produced by players who have won the award multiple times.

article.headline: Milwaukee Brewers Topple Rays in Game 5 to Clinch First World Series
article.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured their first World Series title in the 58-year franchise history by defeating the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 on Wednesday.
article.body:
Jacob Misiorowski delivered a masterclass for the Milwaukee Brewers, firing 5 2/3 innings of two-hit ball before a right calf cramp forced his exit. While the young ace kept the Tampa Bay Rays silent, rookie Cooper Pratt fueled the offense with two hits and two RBIs, propelling the Brewers to a 4-1 victory in Game 5. The win at Tropicana Field transformed the stadium into a celebration for the visiting Milwaukee faithful, who had spent the series chanting behind the dugout. For a team playing in the majors' smallest market, this championship represents the pinnacle of a 58-year wait, finally overcoming the heartbreak of their previous 1982 World Series appearance.

This title victory acts as a sharp rebuke to the long-standing narrative that small-market franchises cannot compete for baseball's top prize. Despite finishing the 2026 season with a franchise-record 103 regular-season wins and their fourth consecutive National League Central title, the team had often been dismissed by critics as an outlier. By sweeping the Dodgers and dismantling the Rays in five games, the Brewers silenced the skepticism regarding their economic viability and on-field endurance.

Manager Pat Murphy, who took the helm in 2024 and earned back-to-back Manager of the Year honors, credited the collective effort of the 2026 roster for the historic result. The series saw individual brilliance from World Series MVP William Contreras, who hit a key RBI double, and rookie sensation Jackson Chourio, who set a five-game series record with 11 hits. The achievement follows a season where Milwaukee dominated the standings for 149 days, consistently defying the odds.

Fans in Milwaukee can now prepare for a victory parade as the team brings the trophy home. This win officially concludes the 2026 season on the highest note, cementing the legacy of a group that captain Christian Yelich described as the best feeling for a city that has waited a long time for a championship.

The team currently features Walker Kessler and Kevon Looney at the center position, and officials viewed the two-way roster spots as a specific avenue to add necessary size to the squad.

Okereke, who joined the Lakers after going undrafted in the 2026 NBA Draft, saw his stint with the team end only a few months after his initial signing. During his final college season at Vanderbilt, the 23-year-old forward had averaged 9.6 points and 3.6 rebounds while shooting 40.0% from three-point range over 36 games.

Lovering, who played four years of college basketball split between Colorado and Utah, entered the NBA path through the Memphis Grizzlies' G League system. He spent most of last season with the Memphis Hustle before signing a 10-day contract with the Grizzlies in February. He returned to the Grizzlies on an Exhibit 10 deal ahead of the 2026-27 season but was waived in late September to make room for another two-way signing.

article.headline: Sacha Baron Cohen revives Ali G for misguided comedy film Who Iz I
article.summary: Sacha Baron Cohen brings back his iconic 2000s character Ali G in the new film Ali G: Who Iz I?, which attempts to navigate modern culture through a series of elaborate pranks.
article.body:
Ali G discovers a fax from HBO offering him a multimillion-dollar deal to return to television, only to arrive in Los Angeles and realize the offer expired 22 years ago. Left without prospects after squandering his previous earnings and moving into his late grandmother's flat, the character attempts to pivot to a career as a TikTok content creator. He films videos featuring mukbangs and outfit hauls alongside local politicians and retired military personnel in an effort to regain his former fame.

The film marks Sacha Baron Cohen’s directorial debut and features a mix of live-ammo hoaxes rather than a traditional narrative structure. By returning to a character that rose to prominence in the early 2000s, the project forces Baron Cohen to confront his own fame, as he is now often recognized by the public he seeks to prank. To manage this challenge, the production utilizes body doubles and covert reshoots to pull off its high-stakes satirical stunts.

According to TheWrap, the movie struggles to find relevance in a culture that has moved past the character’s original style of humor. TheGuardian notes that the project also incorporates performances from previous characters, including the security consultant Erran Morad and liberal activist Dr. Nira Cain-N’Degrocello. One unnamed Republican leader who appeared in the film has already expressed intentions to sue the comedian, labeling the experience an embarrassment.

Ultimately, the production relies on clarifying who is in on the jokes, appearing to address a new generation of viewers who may be unfamiliar with the original series. The film captures a performer attempting to force his legacy into a fragmented, modern media landscape where his original shock tactics face different societal standards.

Livestock owners are facing the reality of potentially reduced grass growth and water scarcity as El Niño shifts weather patterns from this spring onwards. With summer just over a month away, the Ministry for Primary Industries is emphasizing that this event is expected to rank among the strongest seen in recent history.

The shifting climate driver poses a significant challenge for animal owners, particularly those managing cattle, sheep, or horses. According to the Ministry for Primary Industries, the expected conditions create a heightened risk of drought, wildfires, and heat-related health concerns. Failing to prepare for these environmental changes could result in critical shortages of feed and water, forcing owners to destock or face welfare challenges for their animals.

Andrew Curtis, the ministry's national response manager, advises that proactive measures are essential to manage these obligations under the Animal Welfare Act. Recommended steps include booking water tank refills in advance, prioritizing specific livestock for early destocking, and ensuring all animals are shorn before temperatures climb. The ministry has launched a dedicated web resource for lifestyle block owners, providing access to seasonal calendars, fact sheets, and emergency plan templates to help navigate the season.

As the phenomenon intensifies toward its peak, the weather patterns are expected to deliver dry spells to the north of the country while potentially causing heavy rain in southern regions. Farmers and property owners are encouraged to utilize available support materials now, rather than waiting for the most severe impacts to emerge during the coming summer months.

article.headline: AFL Drops Opening Round as 2027 Premiership Season Fixture Finally Lands
article.summary: The 2027 Toyota AFL Premiership Season fixture is now live, introducing Sunday night games and removing the Opening Round.
article.body:
The 2027 Toyota AFL Premiership Season fixture has arrived, setting the stage for 23 games per club in what is the final year of the 18-team structure. While the league claims to aim for balance, the schedule remains a complex puzzle of venues and opponents, with players like Gold Coast's Scott Pendlebury facing a vastly expanded travel map. Pendlebury is slated to play at 13 different venues in his first year with the Suns, a significant increase from his usual experience, including trips to Ballarat, Darwin, and the Barossa.

For fans, the release provides clarity on bye schedules and critical matchups that determine the path to the finals. The difficulty rankings, determined by the 2026 finishing positions of double-up opponents, reveal the hurdles awaiting each club. Understanding this layout is essential for supporters tracking their team's chances, as a low total score in the difficulty calculation indicates a significantly tougher road ahead on paper.

A notable shift this year is the inclusion of Sunday night games, designed to offer more convivial starts in Adelaide and Western Australia. Meanwhile, the league has officially abandoned the "Opening Round" format, a move that ensures no byes for the first 10 rounds of the season. According to The Age, the league structure is expected to shift again in 2028 when the 19th team joins the competition.

The complete schedule is available for fans to review, detailing specific home-and-away assignments from the first round through to the final matches of the year. Clubs and supporters are now recalibrating their expectations based on the finalized dates and locations announced in this latest release.

article.headline: Vera Rubin Observatory Spots Massive Potential New Dwarf Planet Beyond Neptune Orbit
article.summary: Astronomers identified 2026 ED138, a potential new dwarf planet located in the frigid depths beyond Neptune, using data from the Vera Rubin Observatory.
article.body:
The newly identified object, designated 2026 ED138, is estimated to be between 600 and 1500 kilometers wide. This substantial size suggests that the icy body is large enough for its own gravity to sculpt it into a sphere, a defining physical trait that distinguishes a dwarf planet from common asteroids or smaller space rocks. 

Confirming 2026 ED138 as a dwarf planet would be a significant milestone for planetary science. To date, astronomers have only identified five such celestial bodies in our solar system: Pluto, Ceres, Eris, Haumea, and Makemake. Identifying a sixth member of this rare category offers researchers a vital opportunity to further understand the composition of the outer solar system. 

The discovery originated on October 13 when Matthew Holman of the Center for Astrophysics | Harvard & Smithsonian processed data through a custom search code developed with colleague Kevin Napier. The object appeared relatively bright despite its immense distance from the sun, which immediately indicated to researchers that it was larger than the average trans-Neptunian object. Holman described his initial reaction to the finding as one of "excited disbelief," leading him to conduct immediate verification checks against the catalog of the Vera Rubin Observatory.

Located on Cerro Pachón in Chile, the Vera Rubin Observatory began its 10-year Legacy Survey of Space and Time in June 2025. By utilizing a 3.2-gigapixel camera to image the entire southern sky every few days, the observatory aims to create a high-resolution time-lapse of the cosmos. This ongoing survey serves as a comprehensive solar system inventory, expected to assist scientists in mapping out the distant reaches of our cosmic backyard with unprecedented detail.

article.body:
The path to the EFL quarter-finals is officially open, with the winner of tonight’s clash set to travel to League Two side Fleetwood Town. Fleetwood secured their spot in the next stage by defeating Premier League champions Arsenal on penalties earlier this week.

This match offers a high-stakes opportunity for both clubs. For Newcastle United, the objective is to secure a second trophy in three years, building on their successful 2025 League Cup campaign that ended a 56-year wait for silverware. For Everton, the stakes are historical. The club, which halted its long streak of trophy-hoovering in 1995, is hunting for its first major cup success in 31 years. Supporters are increasingly hopeful as this campaign marks the first significant cup run for the club in quite some time.

According to BBC Sport, the winner of this evening's match will join the other quarter-finalists, including Manchester City, Crystal Palace, and Liverpool. The Guardian reports that kickoff at Hill Dickinson Stadium is scheduled for 7:45pm GMT. Only one team will remain in contention for the title past the conclusion of the match, expected around 10pm.
